Name: FishHatchery
Author: zhangjiaxue
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Fish Fry Hatchery is a highly practical mod designed to bridge the gap between fish roe and live fish. Its main purpose is to provide a reliable, automated way to convert any type of fish roe back into its corresponding live fish. This mod is incredibly useful for players who want to easily restock their Fish Ponds, or for those who need fresh, high-quality fish to craft advanced artisan goods like Smoked Fish.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Ensure you have the latest version of SMAPI installed.
Download the mod and extract the .zip file.
Place the FishFryHatchery folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.
Launch the game using SMAPI. The mod will load automatically.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Universal Compatibility: Dynamically reads all registered roe in the game. It seamlessly supports both Vanilla fish and any fish added by other mods (e.g., SVE, RSV, Custom Fish).
Quality Variations: Hatched fish have a randomized quality distribution to add excitement: 50% Normal, 25% Silver, 15% Gold, and 10% Iridium.
Accessible Progression: The crafting recipe is sold at Willy's Fish Shop for 10,000g.
Balanced Crafting: The machine requires 10 Refined Quartz, 2 Seaweed, 2 Green Algae, and 25 Stone to craft.
Fast Turnaround: Each roe takes exactly 1 in-game day to hatch, keeping your farming rhythm smooth.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
SMAPI: The core mod loader for Stardew Valley (Minimum version 3.18.0).
Game Version: Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer.
(Optional) Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM): If you wish to tweak the hatch time or quality probabilities in-game.

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]A huge thank you to the Stardew Valley modding community for the endless inspiration.
Special thanks to the creators of Content Patcher and Custom Machines, whose tools and documentation made this mod possible.
Thank you to all the fish mod authors (SVE, RSV, etc.) for expanding the game's content, which this mod proudly supports![/color]

Manifest.Name: Fish Fry Hatchery 鱼苗孵化场
Manifest.Description: Put fish roe into the Fish Fry Hatchery and after a unified 4 in-game days (configurable, calendar-driven only) it hatches into the matching fish — no menus, no guessing: roe produced by any fish pond is auto-stamped with its own species (herring pond roe hatches herring), roe named after a fish (any fish mod) matches by name/ID, and roe that can't be identified is refused instead of hatching the wrong fish. Tooltip countdown shows the real remaining days. Automation and Hopper feeding from a chest now consumes exactly one roe per batch, same rules as vanilla machines. Lean in-game settings via Generic Mod Config Menu. 放入鱼籽，统一游戏内 4 天（可调）后孵化出对应的鱼：鱼塘产出的鱼籽自动带上鱼种标记（鲱鱼塘=鲱鱼），模组具名鱼籽按名称/ID 匹配，认不出则拒收绝不错出；tooltip 倒计时显示真实剩余天数；箱子/漏斗/自动化模组投料会像原版机器一样准确消耗一份鱼籽，不再免费产鱼；GMCM 设置菜单已精简。
